end.summary:
Identified point, segment, line and ray using endpoints and arrows.
Named segments, lines and rays with letters; identified ray AB as starting at A.
Counted joining segments for 3, 4, 5 and 6 points using listing and n(n-1)/2.
Initially treated a longer line drawing as a different or bigger line; this mix-up was not corrected in a later turn.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised distinguishing points, line segments, lines and rays by endpoints, dots and arrows. They correctly named rays by their starting letter and counted all joining segments, including using n(n-1)/2 for six points. A mix-up remained about whether a longer drawing represents a different or bigger line; revisit that a line remains unlimited in both directions regardless of the drawing’s length. At home, ask them to label one example of each figure and explain which endpoints or arrows identify it.
